decision.summary: The screened region (495–498) shows a rapid multi-sample increase in all components, but the post-event behavior (indices 498–533) remains elevated and non-stationary, with no clear return to pre-event baseline. This suggests either a permanent step or sustained deformation rather than a temporary offset. No confirmed temporary offset intervals exist within allowed context [460,533].
